titolo: Clip 02 - GTA 6 pre-load: what you need

scene.voce: GTA 6 is 212 gigabytes. So yes, something on your console has to die. Here's everything you need before November 19.
Number one. Pre-load starts November 10. On PS5, it's midnight your local time. On Xbox, it's midnight UK time, so in America that's the afternoon of the ninth.
Number two. You'll need up to 212 gigabytes free. Start deleting now, not at 11:59 on launch night.
Number three. Buying the boxed copy? There's no disc inside, just a download code. Those hit stores November 12, so you're downloading either way.
Number four. Get it by launch day and you also unlock the Vintage Vice City Pack. Free drip is still drip.
So where are you playing? PS5 or Xbox? Tell me in the comments. And go clear that space tonight.
